reviewType: Independent read-only source and test review; no test execution by reviewer
findings: Complete same-paragraph packets are validated before any replacement; instruction fragments are assembled.
Only PAGE/NUMPAGES with optional MERGEFORMAT and a sole ordinary unlocked cached run are promoted.
Converted fields preserve the cached display once in the existing style/link and attached-comment path.
Unsupported, malformed, locked, nested, atomic, multi-run and mixed-content packets use ordinary cached serialization.
XML, numeric-format and out-of-range codepoint errors safely retain the cache.
No text-suppression state remains; the cross-paragraph guard only prevents nested promotion.
Independent auxiliary stories save/reset/restore the guard.
Prior column, tab, paragraph-break, keep-together, note, table and page-suffix implementations remain unchanged.
testHelperReview: Corrected helper decodes ODF spaces, tabs and line breaks; final malformed-metadata loop covers negative and out-of-range numeric entities.
